skill.name: ai-sdk
skill.description: Helps developers build and troubleshoot Vercel AI SDK features. It checks current docs, source files, migration errors, AI Gateway usage, and type-safe agent patterns.
skill.summary: Build current Vercel AI SDK features with docs-first guidance.

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged hardcoded documentation URLs, placeholder environment-file examples, TypeScript relative imports, and Markdown backtick text. Review found no prompt injection, secret exfiltration, user-controlled command execution, or malicious intent in the scanned files.

remediation.suggestion: State that installing the ai package should happen only after the user approves dependency changes.

remediation.issue: Network lookup guidance relies on public documentation and model-list endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users before making ai-sdk.dev or ai-gateway.vercel.sh requests, and keep lookups limited to those documented endpoints.

content.user_title: Build AI SDK Features with Current Docs
content.value_statement: AI SDK APIs change quickly, which can make generated code outdated. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to current docs and migration patterns.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to verify AI SDK APIs in local docs and source files.
Guides work with generateText, streamText, useChat, tools, embeddings, and structured output.
Documents common AI SDK migration errors and current replacement APIs.
Explains Vercel AI Gateway authentication, model selection, and provider usage.
Shows type-safe ToolLoopAgent and useChat patterns with inferred UI message types.
limitations: It does not provide provider credentials or create Vercel accounts.
It depends on local AI SDK docs or public ai-sdk.dev documentation being available.
It may require user approval before package installation or external documentation lookups.
It focuses on TypeScript AI SDK usage, not general machine learning model design.

use_cases.title: Build a Streaming Chat
use_cases.description: Create a chat experience that uses current useChat and streaming response patterns.

use_cases.title: Standardize AI Gateway Usage
use_cases.description: Choose current provider model IDs and configure AI Gateway patterns across a project.

use_cases.title: Migrate Older AI SDK Code
use_cases.description: Update deprecated options, message formats, and tool part handling to current APIs.

prompt_templates.title: Check an AI SDK API
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify the current AI SDK API for my task before making changes. Use local docs first, then ai-sdk.dev if needed.

prompt_templates.title: Build Streaming Chat
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a streaming chat feature with the current AI SDK patterns. Check common useChat errors before writing client code.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Deprecated Usage
prompt_templates.scenario: Fix code written for an older AI SDK version.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AI SDK code for deprecated APIs and update it to the current patterns. Explain each migration decision briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Type-Safe Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced agent implementation with typed tool results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ToolLoopAgent with type-safe useChat rendering. Include where agent files, tool files, and UI message types should live.

output_examples.input: I need a Next.js chat page using the AI SDK.
output_examples.output: A short implementation plan, current useChat guidance, server streaming notes, and a reminder to run type checks after changes.

output_examples.input: Which Anthropic model should I use through AI Gateway?
output_examples.output: Instructions to fetch the current provider model list, select the newest suitable model, and avoid remembered model IDs.

output_examples.input: My tool result rendering fails after upgrading useChat.
output_examples.output: A diagnosis of typed tool parts, renamed state values, and the correct checks needed before reading tool input or output.

best_practices: Verify current APIs in local docs or ai-sdk.dev before changing code.
Check current AI Gateway model IDs before choosing provider models.
Run type checks after implementing AI SDK changes.
anti_patterns: Relying on remembered AI SDK API names without checking documentation.
Using deprecated useChat input handlers or generic tool-invocation parts.
Adding provider packages before the project actually needs them.

faq.question: Does this skill write AI SDK code?
faq.answer: It guides the agent to write and update TypeScript AI SDK code when the user asks for implementation help.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: It can use ai-sdk.dev or Vercel AI Gateway when local docs are unavailable or model IDs must be current.

faq.question: Will it install packages automatically?
faq.answer: It recommends installing only the ai package when local docs are missing. Users should approve dependency changes first.

faq.question: Which AI tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What AI SDK topics are covered?
faq.answer: It covers text generation, streaming, tools, structured output, embeddings, AI Gateway, agents, and useChat patterns.

faq.question: Does it include real secrets?
faq.answer: No. It shows a placeholder API key format and expects users to provide credentials through secure project configuration.
